antipattern.code:
import pytest
from vllm import LLM

def test_bge_model():
    """Test BGE embedding model with single mode."""
    model_name = "BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5"
    llm = LLM(model=model_name, task="embed")
    outputs = llm.encode(["Hello, world!"])
    assert len(outputs) > 0

def test_bge_model_aclgraph():
    """Test BGE embedding model with aclgraph mode."""
    model_name = "BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5"
    llm = LLM(model=model_name, task="embed",
              enforce_eager=False)
    outputs = llm.embed(["Hello, world!"])
    assert len(outputs) > 0
    check_embeddings_close(
        name_0="hf",      # 实际对应 vllm_outputs (eager)
        name_1="vllm",    # 实际对应 vllm_aclgraph_outputs
        vllm_outputs=vllm_outputs,
        vllm_aclgraph_outputs=vllm_aclgraph_outputs,
        ...
    )

pattern.code:
import pytest
from vllm import LLM

def test_bge_model_correctness(hf_runner, vllm_runner):
    """Test BGE embedding model correctness across eager, aclgraph, hf."""
    model_name = "BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5"
    example_prompts = ["Hello, world!", "This is a test."]

    with hf_runner(model_name, dtype="float32") as hf_model:
        hf_outputs = hf_model.encode(example_prompts)

    with vllm_runner(model_name, task="embed",
                     dtype="float32", enforce_eager=True) as vllm_model:
        vllm_outputs = vllm_model.encode(example_prompts)

    with vllm_runner(model_name, task="embed",
                     dtype="float32", enforce_eager=False) as vllm_model:
        vllm_aclgraph_outputs = vllm_model.encode(example_prompts)

    check_embeddings_close(
        name_0="vllm_eager",
        name_1="vllm_aclgraph",
        vllm_outputs=vllm_outputs,
        vllm_aclgraph_outputs=vllm_aclgraph_outputs,
        hf_outputs=hf_outputs,
        ...
    )
